digest.component_or_area: rebar link command and caused_by relation validation
propositions: caused_by links accept any target without validating whether that target has a referencing commit, allowing misattributed causation edges
the referencing-commit scan exists only in close_precheck._referencing_commits, conflating success with no-history
rebar link must refuse caused_by edges whose target has no referencing commit, unless --force is provided
the refusal logic must run identically in library, CLI, and MCP code paths, using a shared predicate in link_revert.py
a commit-less code repository (unverifiable state) must allow the link, distinguishing from refusal (target provably has no commit)
the --force escape hatch with optional reason must be implemented once in extract_force and reused by claim and link
